answer: Tie each agent key to a hardware root of trust. The key is created inside a TPM or secure enclave, and registration must include the chip's manufacturer-signed endorsement certificate; the ledger lets one chip back at most two agents. A cloned VM cannot mirror that certificate, since the endorsement key never leaves the silicon, so a thousand sybils means buying five hundred real devices. Whether an agent writes a sonnet or plans a willow garden, its standing traces to one physical chip.
